title: MarineMax Charleston Hosts 5th Annual Boats, Brews, and Band Fall Boat Show to Benefit Dorchester Paws
summary: Annual Boats, Brews, and Band Fall Boat Show to Benefit Dorchester Paws CHARLESTON, SC (November 11, 2026)— MarineMax Charleston will host its 5th Annual Boats, Brews, and Band Fall Boat Show on Saturday, November 14, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at MarineMax Charleston
body_markdown:
**CHARLESTON, SC (November 11, 2026)** — MarineMax Charleston will host its 5


th


Annual Boats, Brews, and Band Fall Boat Show on Saturday, November 14, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at MarineMax Charleston, 152 Sportsman Island Drive. This family-friendly event combines a fall boat show with live music from Wildflower Station, craft beer from local breweries, and food from local food trucks.


The event will benefit Dorchester Paws, with on-site animal adoptions. MarineMax Charleston will cover the adoption fees for the first four adopters, helping match families with their own furry first mate.


Guests can browse boats to fit a range of lifestyles and budgets, including the latest models from Boston Whaler, Scout, Saxdor, and Sea Ray. Other marina vendors and Charleston-area marine businesses will also be on site, with seasonal savings available throughout the event.


“We’re proud to bring the Charleston boating community together for the fifth year, and even prouder to support Dorchester Paws. Whether you’re shopping for a new boat or just here for the music and a cold beer, we hope you’ll meet a new best friend while you’re here,” said Karl Anderson, General Manager.
